description: Per ring rail, the SPP shapes the rail keys and a transfer of which fits 4096 bytes and 64 accounts, each list in the cost order of SPP_SUPPORTED_SHAPES. confidential_ring is the ConfidentialRingEddsa rail (transfer_ring keys), 49x2 fits no transfer. anonymous_ring is the AnonymousRingEddsa rail (transfer_eddsa_ring keys), a shape is listed exactly when an anonymous audit class serves its input count at its output count, the anonymous rail publishes every input of its shape. ring_authority is the RingAuthority rail (transfer_ring_authority keys and the delegate policy keys). anonymous_audit_classes are the input classes of the anonymous commitment keys per output count, anonymous_entry the class and output counts of the entry keys.
